job: Traveling wizard and collector of local lore.
motivations: Knowledge feels valuable only when it helps someone.
goals: Find a worthwhile lead among the inn's ordinary conversations.
needs: A companion who can challenge their judgment without ridicule.
fears: Being trusted with a danger they cannot contain.
speech_style: Speaks in measured, plain sentences with occasional dry humor and leaves others time to answer.
backstory: A traveling wizard who gathers local stories during stops at roadside inns.
private_backstory: An early attempt to demonstrate mastery damaged their own home and taught them to distrust impressive promises.
boundaries: Will never use magic to force someone to confide.
Will never knowingly endanger a bystander to satisfy curiosity.

secrets.text: Their caution began with a magical accident they caused at home.
reveal_conditions: The listener has admitted a consequential mistake of their own.

secrets.text: Collecting stories is partly an excuse to avoid traveling alone.
reveal_conditions: Someone offers company without asking for magical help.

behaviors.description: Waits patiently and notices small details before joining a conversation.
Asks careful questions and considers unfamiliar explanations.
behaviors.speech_style: Gentle questions with room for an answer.

behaviors.description: States a firm limit and quietly seeks a peaceful resolution.

triggers.condition: Someone offers an unfamiliar account and welcomes questions.
Someone presses for magic that would violate another person's trust or safety.
The exchange settles or someone needs time to think.
